children: Ondo has launched Intelligent Portfolios, three onchain investment portfolios delivered as single transferable tokens: BLKHIon, BLKDIGon and BLKGRWon. The products are based on BlackRock model portfolio strategies and are live on Ethereum and BNB Chain, with settlement through CoW Protocol for eligible non-US investors.

Each portfolio wraps a BlackRock model strategy into one token, so eligible investors can hold and transfer a diversified allocation without managing individual components. This is the first time BlackRock-powered tokenized portfolios appear on Ethereum and BNB Chain, which extends Ondo's position in institutional tokenization beyond single-asset products.

For ONDO, the launch is a repricing catalyst tied to expected platform inflows rather than token mechanics, since the portfolios carry no direct token-economic features. Adoption of the three tokens on the two chains will determine how much demand actually reaches the platform.
Rebalancing a portfolio used to take a lot of clicks.
just put the whole thing in a single token, with rebalancing handled at the smart contract level.
Intelligent Portfolios are live on Ethereum and BNB Chain, all settled through CoW Protocol.

title: Ondo: Intelligent Portfolios go live with BlackRock model strategies on Ethereum and BNB Chain - 24 Sep 2026
